draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Baga! Together with Calangute just 2 km south, this is where Goa's tourism all started, when the flower-children arrived from the late 1960s. Nobody's quite sure where Baga ends and Calangute begins.
draft.hungryLine: Baga eats everything from cheap shacks to multi-course feasts, and some shacks throw barbeque nights with freshly caught seafood.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Baga Beach is a 7 minute walk, then wander over to Baga Creek, the little tidal estuary at the north end.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Pop into Our Lady of Candelaria Chapel, a minute away, or find a beach shack and settle in for the afternoon.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Tito's, right by the beach, opened in 1971 and has hosted the likes of the Beatles, Dire Straits and Kate Moss.

spots.name: Baga Beach
spots.detail: 7 min walk · Shallow water, no waves, lifeguards on watch

spots.name: Baga Creek
spots.detail: In Baga · Tidal estuary where two streams meet the sea

spots.name: Calangute Beach
spots.detail: 2 km south · The largest beach in North Goa

tips.title: Know the peak seasons.
tips.body: Calangute's peak season is Christmas and New Year, plus the summer in May, so expect crowds then.

tips.title: Bring the kids to Baga.
tips.body: The beach has no waves, a shallow entry and lifeguards, which makes it great for families.

story.title: A fishing coast
story.body: Calangute was a fishing village before it was a resort. Baga Creek, formed by two streams meeting at Arpora, drains into the sea here.

story.title: The flower-children
story.body: From the late 1960s the hippies descended on Calangute, Baga and Candolim. This stretch is where Goa's tourism began.

story.title: Clubs and hotels
story.body: An expat opened Tito's in 1971, and it went on to draw celebrities from around the world. Around 1987 the Ronil Royale opened, one of the first Goan-style hotels in Calangute Baga.

story.title: A hard lesson
story.body: On 6 December 2025 a fire at a nightclub in nearby Arpora killed 25 people, most of them club staff. The government ordered audits of all the night clubs in the area.

food.name: Danny's Grill Kebabs and Curries
food.detail: On Baga Creek, try the lobster tandoori or pork chops, then bebinca with ice cream

food.name: Brito's
food.detail: Known for its mixed meat platter and good desserts

food.name: J & A's Little Italy
food.detail: Superb Italian food in a relaxed setting
